tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Primary ink. Body text, headings, prices. 14.6:1 on bench.

tokens.name: graphite-frame
tokens.usage: The frame: site header, hero panels, footer. Always paired with frame-ink.

tokens.name: frame-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on graphite-frame.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: The one loud colour. Buy buttons, sale badges, active states. Text on copper is graphite (4.7:1), never white (3.4:1 fails).

tokens.name: copper-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on copper.

tokens.name: copper-text
tokens.usage: Copper used as text or links on light grounds (5.2:1 on white). Never use plain copper for text.

tokens.name: bench
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Product cards, panels, inputs. Packshots always sit on white in light theme.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Category tiles, chips, quiet fills.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Card borders and dividers. Borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text: brand line, VAT note, was-price. 5.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: stock-in
tokens.usage: In stock. Stock status only, never decoration.

tokens.name: stock-low
tokens.usage: Low stock (5 or fewer at a warehouse) or incoming with an ETA.

tokens.name: stock-out
tokens.usage: Out of stock at that warehouse. Also form errors.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside cards between lines, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, product grid gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile, gaps between blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between homepage sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Product cards, category tiles, hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, search bar.
